name: Transaction Processing Status 3 Code
definition: Provides the processing status of a transaction (at account servicer level).

PACK.name: Acknowledged Accepted
PACK.definition: Instruction has been acknowledged/accepted for further processing by the account servicer.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Instruction has been rejected for further processing.

REPR.name: In Repair
REPR.definition: Instruction is accepted but in repair.
